entries.summary: Added a Map source switch in Settings → Menus to show Amap (高德) tiles instead of OpenStreetMap on every map, with automatic GCJ-02 conversion so markers, routes and taps stay accurate; saved data remains in standard GPS coordinates.
The app now opens on the Map while spoofing is on, and on Home while it's off.
When the group leader teleports, followers now jump there too. Turn off Follow leader teleports to walk instead.
On first launch, the map now opens at your phone's real location instead of a default city. Your remembered position still wins when you have one.
A small credit for the map provider (OpenStreetMap contributors or Amap) now shows in the corner of every map, as the provider's terms require.
A small badge on the home screen now tells you when a newer version is available.
Capture now walks you through setup with step cards until this app is your default browser, and a new menu lets you restore your previous default browser.
The roaming sheet now shows one mode at a time, with a button to switch between Walk around and Planting.
Joining a group now turns on Follow leader automatically.
When a group leader taps Stop, followers now pause cleanly and resume when the leader starts again, instead of losing the connection.
Maps now keep up to 200 MB of tiles you've already viewed, so places you revisit load faster.
Fixed a rare crash when coming back to the app with a map open.
Tapping the center-on-map button repeatedly no longer lags.
Cards and sheets have a flatter, rounder look with clearer surface colors.
Added Traditional Chinese (繁體中文) as a display language.
